context: Transcript-derived cleanup: remove fake one-Optional stream/list flow while preserving checked prompt and YAML parsing boundaries.

checklist.name: Compiles and creates requested artifact
checklist.description: Creates a coherent StoreSetup.java with the requested class, constructor, interfaces, method signatures, imports, and Java 17-compatible code.

checklist.name: Preserves warehouse prompt behavior
checklist.description: warehouseId returns the configured warehouse id when present, calls terminal.readLine("Warehouse: ") only when absent, and preserves IOException.

checklist.name: Preserves requested port behavior
checklist.description: serverPort validates and returns the requested port when present, and only searches for the next available port when absent.

checklist.name: Preserves YAML parsing behavior
checklist.description: readYamlFrontMatter returns Optional.empty() when absent, parses present text with yaml.readValue(...), and preserves IOException without wrapping it.

checklist.name: Uses direct Optional flow for ordinary values
checklist.description: Uses map(...).orElseGet(...) or an equivalent value-binding Optional shape for the server-port branch where no checked exception prevents it.

checklist.name: Keeps checked boundaries narrow
checklist.description: Uses plain branching only where terminal.readLine(...) or yaml.readValue(...) can throw IOException, without turning that into a generic Optional abstraction.

checklist.name: Avoids fake Optional collections and helpers
checklist.description: Does not use Optional.stream().toList(), stream()::iterator, optionalValues, presentValues, OptionalSupport, OptionalValues, CheckedOptionals, UncheckedIOException, or another helper/dependency to make one Optional iterable or to tunnel checked exceptions.
